method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING.md §6.5 manual validation (run_loop.py uses select(), broken on Windows per §6.4). FULL RE-RUN 2026-06-11 against the read-framed description (HCBR-2026-06-11-03 fix: 'Author or interpret', read-side audit cases, 'before writing or reading' closing): all 20 original queries re-measured + 6 new (q21-24 read-side should-trigger incl. the verbatim field-failure task; q25-26 read-shaped should-not near-misses). Empirical step = independent fan-out of 26 fresh-context agents, one per query, each shown a neutral menu of 9 skill descriptions (SPID at C among realistic siblings, NOT flagged as under-test; sibling authoring skills shown with abridged versions of their own new read-framed descriptions, matching deployment) + one query, asked which ONE skill to load (or NONE) + reasoning. Anonymized per feedback_skill_trigger_eval_fanout; agents told to judge ONLY the menu, use no tools beyond reading it, and ignore environment skills. Verdicts adjudicated from each agent's REASONING + pick. Menu: A=SkyPatcher edit-record-fields, B=KID keywords-to-items, C=SPID distribute-to-NPCs [under test], D=CID items-to-containers, E=mutagen-reference record-schema, F=crash-diagnostics, G=conflict-resolution, H=papyrus-reference, I=modding-basics. Menu + raw run-record in dev/skill-validation/2026-06-11-read-triggers/ (private). Supersedes the 2026-06-02 run (whose 20 queries are q1-q20 here, all verdicts reconfirmed).

result.notes: All 14 should-trigger picked C — the 10 originals (write-side, reconfirmed) and all 4 new read-side cases: q21 is the VERBATIM HCBR-2026-06-11-03 field-failure task ('check Authoria - Modded Outfit Distribution... assigning an outfit to NPC- Mjoll', _DISTR.ini context) which the old write-framed description missed; q22 what-does-this-_DISTR-do; q23 does-it-affect-Serana/unique-filter; q24 audit-why-no-distribution. Agents explicitly cited the new interpretation clause ('asks what an existing _DISTR.ini does, whether a given NPC is targeted by it'). All 12 should-not routed elsewhere, incl. the two new read-shaped near-misses: q25 (read-only SkyPatcher-ini-on-NPC question → A: agents keyed on framework, not read-verb) and q26 (read a Papyrus script for NPC spell adds → H: artifact type beats 'spells to NPCs' phrasing). Hard originals all held: q18/q19 name SPID but are install/conceptual → I; q20 runtime-mass-edit on ITEMS → A. Every manual_predicted_trigger matched the measured verdict.
result.peer_review: Author prediction + 26 independent fresh-context agents (exceeds §6.5's 'one peer reviewer checks 3 random'). Re-run required by PR #42 independent review (stale-eval blocking finding). Aaron may spot-check any query.
result.carry_forward: KI-S5-V1X-1: re-run on the next release that ships a Windows-compatible eval runner (run_loop.py select() fix), per §6.4.
